title: Bill Gates, Leon Black Testimony Sought for Epstein Probe
title_zh: 爱泼斯坦调查寻求比尔·盖茨和莱昂·布莱克的证词
summary: The two billionaires were among seven people House Oversight Committee Chair James Comer sent letters to on Tuesday requesting interviews for the panel’s investigation. Other recipients include Goldman Sachs Group Inc.
summary_zh: 这两位亿万富翁是众议院监督委员会主席詹姆斯·科默周二致函的七人之一，要求对该小组的调查进行采访。其他获奖者包括高盛集团公司。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slide as Iran war volatility continues
title_zh: 今日股市：伊朗战争波动持续，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: Wall Street is scrambling to settle as the war in the Middle East is causing volatility across the board.
summary_zh: 随着中东战争引发全面动荡，华尔街正忙着平息局势。

title: OpenAI is developing alternative to Microsoft's GitHub, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 正在开发微软 GitHub 的替代品
summary: OpenAI is developing a new code-hosting platform to rival Microsoft's GitHub, ‌The Information reported on Tuesday, citing a ‌person with knowledge of the project.
summary_zh: 据《The Information》周二援引一位了解该项目的人士的话报道，OpenAI 正在开发一个新的代码托管平台，以与微软的 GitHub 竞争。

title: Apple unveils new MacBooks powered by M5 chips
title_zh: Apple 推出搭载 M5 芯片的新款 MacBook
summary: Alongside its new low-cost iPhone 17e, Apple (AAPL) has teased its new MacBook Air and MacBook Pro powered by more powerful M5 Pro and M5 Max chips ahead of its product launch event on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 除了新款低成本 iPhone 17e 之外，苹果 (AAPL) 在周三的产品发布会前还预告了搭载更强大的 M5 Pro 和 M5 Max 芯片的新款 MacBook Air 和 MacBook Pro。

title: Earnings live: Ross Stores stock jumps on upbeat results, CrowdStrike posts slight top- and bottom-line beats
title_zh: 实时财报：Ross Stores 股价因乐观业绩而上涨，CrowdStrike 的营收和利润略有好转
summary: The S&P 500 was on track for double-digit earnings growth, with more than half of companies having reported Q4 results so far.
summary_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数有望实现两位数的盈利增长，迄今为止已有超过一半的公司公布了第四季度业绩。

title: Oil prices still surging as stocks navigate geopolitical pressures
title_zh: 随着股市应对地缘政治压力，油价仍在飙升
summary: US markets (^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC) are still in negative territory but clawing back some ground ahead of Tuesday's market close.
summary_zh: 美国市场（^DJI、^GSPC、^IXIC）仍处于负值区域，但在周二收盘前收复部分失地。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq trim losses but end sharply lower as Wall Street assesses Iran war worries
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数收窄跌幅，但因华尔街评估伊朗战争担忧而大幅收低
summary: The fresh wave of Israeli-led attacks has jolted markets that on Monday mostly managed to shake off the initial shock of the outbreak.
summary_zh: 以色列领导的新一波袭击震动了周一的市场，市场基本上摆脱了疫情爆发的最初冲击。

title: Virginia appeals injunction against social media time limit for children
title_zh: 弗吉尼亚州对儿童社交媒体时间限制禁令提出上诉
summary: By Jonathan Stempel March 3 (Reuters) - Virginia has appealed a judge's preliminary injunction against a state law limiting children under 16 to one hour of social media use a day.
summary_zh: 乔纳森·斯坦普尔 (Jonathan Stempel) 3 月 3 日（路透社）——弗吉尼亚州已对法官针对一项限制 16 岁以下儿童每天使用社交媒体一小时的州法律的初步禁令提出上诉。

title: US strikes in Iran 'reinforce' a coming surge in defense spending. 3 key contractors are set to benefit.
title_zh: 美国对伊朗的打击“强化”了即将到来的国防开支激增。 3 个主要承包商将受益。
summary: As geopolitical shocks send indexes into the red, a 20% valuation gap and a surge in Pentagon contracts make the defense sector the ultimate hedge.
summary_zh: 随着地缘政治冲击导致指数出现亏损，20% 的估值差距和五角大楼合同的激增使国防部门成为最终的对冲工具。
